wyt41xaz.sourceDescription: This metal Christmas tree is ideal for anyone who loves DIY decoration and is looking for Christmas trees with a modern look. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat.
